# Heat Pump Fleet (HeatPumpFleetAdapter)

> **Class**: `energysim.container.HeatPumpFleetAdapter` | add to a world with `add_fleet(fleet_type='heat_pump', ...)` (accepted kinds: `heat_pump`, `hp`, `heat_pump_fleet`)

## Overview

Vectorized Heat Pump fleet adapter with Carnot temperature lift COP.

Simulates N residential or commercial heat pumps simultaneously:
  COP = eta_carnot * (T_sink + 273.15) / max(5.0, (T_sink - T_source))
  COP clamped to [cop_min, cop_max] (typically [1.2, 7.0])

Supports thermal setpoint mode (given q_th_cmd_kw, computes p_el_kw = q_th / COP)
and electrical setpoint mode (given p_el_cmd_kw, computes q_th_kw = COP * p_el).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | `'heat_pump_fleet'` | - | Container (simulator) name. |
| `size` | `int` | `100` | - | Number of entities N in the fleet. |
| `q_max_th_kw` | `Union[float, np.ndarray]` | `10.0` | kW | Maximum thermal heating capacity per unit (scalar or length-N array). |
| `carnot_efficiency` | `float` | `0.5` | 1 | Carnot efficiency multiplier (default 0.50). |
| `cop_min` | `float` | `1.2` | 1 | Minimum clamped COP floor (default 1.2). |
| `cop_max` | `float` | `7.0` | 1 | Maximum clamped COP ceiling (default 7.0). |
| `step_size` | `float` | `900.0` | s | Micro time-step. |

## Inputs

| Variable | Unit | Aliases |
|---|---|---|
| `t_ambient` | unspecified | `t_amb`, `t_source` |
| `t_sink` | unspecified | `t_flow` |
| `q_th_cmd_kw` | kW | `q_demand`, `q_cmd` |
| `p_el_cmd_kw` | kW | - |

## Outputs

| Variable | Unit | Aliases |
|---|---|---|
| `p_el_kw` | kW | `p_el`, `power` |
| `q_th_kw` | kW | `q_th`, `heat` |
| `cop` | unspecified | - |

Every output `<var>` is also available as `total_<var>`, `mean_<var>`, `min_<var>`, `max_<var>` and per entity as `<var>[i]`. Units that read `unspecified` are not declared by the container; connections to or from them are never rescaled (see [Units](../units.md)).

## Validation

The fleet is tested against an explicit loop of scalar models (`tests/strengths/test_vectorized_fleets.py`); see [Validation](../validation.md).

## Usage example

```python
from energysim import world

sim = world(start_time=0, stop_time=3600, t_macro=900, power_unit='kW')
sim.add_fleet(fleet_type='heat_pump', name='heat_pumps', size=500, q_max_th_kw=10.0,
              carnot_efficiency=0.50, step_size=900, power_unit='kW')
sim.add_signal('t_amb', lambda t: [5.0], step_size=900)
sim.add_signal('heat_req', lambda t: [7.5], step_size=900)
sim.add_connections({'t_amb.y': 'heat_pumps.t_ambient', 'heat_req.y': 'heat_pumps.q_th_cmd_kw'})
res = sim.simulate()
print(res['heat_pumps.total_p_el_kw'])
```
